description: This file defines the SmsHandler class, responsible for handling SMS operations such as sending and searching SMS messages within an Android application. It interacts with the SmsManager for core SMS functionalities and constructs appropriate results for gateway sessions.

classes.name: SmsHandler
classes.description: A class that handles SMS sending and searching operations, wrapping SmsManager calls and producing GatewaySession results.

methods.name: handleSmsSend
methods.description: Handles sending an SMS message given parameters in JSON format, returning a result indicating success or failure.

methods.name: handleSmsSearch
methods.description: Performs a search for SMS messages based on provided JSON parameters, returning the operation result.

methods.name: errorResult
methods.description: Constructs an error result object for GatewaySession, parsing error messages and error codes.
